description: This file is a Java unit test class for the BackOffActor in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging.backoff package. It contains test methods to verify the behavior of the BackOffActor, including back-off timing, message delay, reset behavior, and maximum back-off time constraints.

classes.name: BackOffActorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the BackOffActor's functionality, including back-off timing, message handling, reset behavior, and maximum timeout limits.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem before all tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after all tests.

methods.name: receiveMessageAfterBackOff
methods.description: Tests that a message sent to the actor is received after the back-off delay.

methods.name: backOffDuringBackOffWillDelayMessage
methods.description: Verifies that messages sent during a back-off period are delayed appropriately and only received after the back-off.

methods.name: backOffDelayWillBeResetAfterSomeTime
methods.description: Checks that the back-off timer resets correctly after some idle time, and the message is delayed accordingly.

methods.name: providesInformationIfCurrentlyInBackOff
methods.description: Tests the actor's response to inquiries about whether it is currently in back-off mode.

methods.name: assertIsInBackOffMode
methods.description: Helper method to assert whether the actor reports being in back-off mode.

methods.name: maxBackOffTimeIsNotExceeded
methods.description: Ensures that the back-off delay does not exceed the configured maximum back-off time.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Helper method to determine the minimum of two Durations.

methods.name: createBackOffConfig
methods.description: Helper method to create a BackOffConfig with specified minimum and maximum timeouts.
